clause: Tonal adjustments family (Brightness/Contrast, Levels, Curves, Exposure, Shadows/Highlights, HDR Toning, Equalize) [STU-RAS-035]

scope.summary: Implement the tonal StudioAdjustment kinds over the framework (MT-054): Brightness/Contrast (legacy-mode option), Levels (black/white/gamma per composite or channel, eyedroppers, auto), Curves (point-editable curve per composite/channel, on-image targeting, eyedroppers, auto algorithms), Exposure (exposure/offset/gamma), Shadows/Highlights (per-range recovery with amount/tone-width/radius/color-correction/midtone-contrast), HDR Toning (32-bit tone-map with exposure/gamma/highlight-compression/local-adaptation/detail), and Equalize.
acceptance_criteria: all 7 tonal adjustment kinds as non-destructive layers + apply-in-place
expected_tests: live: Curves with an on-image target point remaps tone; Levels black/white/gamma per channel; Shadows/Highlights recovers a blown highlight — each as a re-editable adjustment layer
test: apply-in-place emits a distinct history entry

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Tonal adjustments (levels, curves, exposure)

risk_if_missed: No tonal correction; core photo-editing exposure/contrast workflow absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
